policy: Remove introduced type diagnostics attributable to explicitly exception-expected test scenarios, including fall-through code after an operation expected to throw. Keep failures in normal paths of mixed files, ordinary setup and error-reporting code, unrelated calls inside a try block, platform-dependent success/exception cases, and non-source-located diagnostics. Existing syntax diagnostics and incomplete analyses are not reclassified.

review: Inspected enclosing methods, annotations, try/catch regions and invocation ancestors for every source-located introduced diagnostic in all 487 affected files using Spoon. Reviewed custom exception helpers and declarative failure markers against source. Source hashes match the original audit. No re-execution of the verifier or JDK tests was needed. Follow-up refinement investigation found one missed custom tryCatch helper in java/lang/String/Exceptions.java; the filter now excludes it as well.
